title: Herding Ball For Dogs, 25 Inch Large Dog Ball Toy With Handles, Anti Burst Interactive Toy For Large Breeds, German Shepherds, Rottweilers, Agility Training Exercise
body_html:
• 【Ideal Size for Medium Breeds】 The 17.7 inch diameter is the perfect sweet spot for Border Collies and Australian Shepherds. This herding ball mimics livestock movement to satisfy their chasing instincts while reducing anxiety and destructive chewing.
  • 【Rapid Setup and Anti Bite Tip】 Includes a high efficiency air pump for fast setup. Fully inflate until the cover is tight and wrinkle free to prevent dogs from getting a tooth hold. The hidden zipper design further protects the closure from chewing.
  • 【Interactive Agility Exercise】 Enhance your bond through active outdoor play. This interactive toy is perfect for burning off excess energy, teaching focus, and keeping high energy companions physically and mentally stimulated in the backyard.
